reason: The V0/V0.1 custom 0.11 x 0.05 x 0.18 m block was rejected before any FastWAM evaluation: an exhaustive simulator contact-point diagnostic found that no available grasp lifted the block. V0.2 adopts the exact procedural long-block geometry used by RoboTwin's native handover_block task so that graspability is a simulator-supported property rather than a model-tuned special case.
benchmark_selection_basis: simulator-only validity; no FastWAM result exists for V0, V0.1, or V0.2
instruction: Put the can into the basket.

task_configuration.can_and_basket: Unmodified native place_can_basket asset/model/pose sampling and arm selection

conditions.visible: Block starts and is handed off at the canonical revealed pose.
conditions.missing: Block starts and is handed off at the occluding pose; no intervention is applied.
conditions.oracle_reveal: Pre-intervention state is identical to missing; before the first policy observation only the block root pose is set to the canonical visible pose and its velocities are zeroed.

task_configuration.paired_state_protocol: Same seed and identical construction path; condition affects only block initial/intervention pose. Every condition advances five physics steps before handoff.

visibility.missing_requirement: can segmentation pixels == 0 independently in head, left wrist, and right wrist cameras
visibility.visible_and_oracle_requirement: at least one camera has >= 32 can segmentation pixels
visibility.detector: SAPIEN actor instance segmentation, not RGB heuristics

task_configuration.success: Basket upright; can center geometrically contained; can contacts basket; can-side gripper open; can/basket relative motion stable for 25 consecutive physics steps. Block state is ignored.

unchanged_from_v0_1: can and basket assets, models, masses, poses, and sampling ranges
block color, mass, occluding-pose rule, and revealed-pose rule

block_geometry.basis: Exact native handover_block geometry; required because the prior candidate failed simulator-only graspability.

expert_contact_selection.before: Arm-specific contact 1/2 workaround on the invalid custom geometry
expert_contact_selection.after: Native handover_block contact candidate set [0,1,2,3] on the exact native geometry

default_reproduction_gpus.note: Operational only; the fail-closed preflight still accepts only physical GPUs 4-7 and refuses any target card with a non-Xorg process.
